nodes.label: Retro-Brutalist 80s Design Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Interface is reverent, not costume: CRT phosphor glow on wet-concrete black, scanlines, monospaced terminals, VHS color. Building a machine for looking at photographs — restraint and signal density matter more than friendliness.

nodes.label: Color Token System
nodes.rationale: Dark mode is canonical; light mode is a secondary cooled-paper inversion triggered by data-theme=light and must never be the default. Phosphor green is primary accent used sparingly; amber marks digital zone; neon-red is danger/admin.

nodes.label: Typography System
nodes.rationale: All monospaced or geometric families (VT323, Share Tech Mono, IBM Plex Mono, Orbitron). No humanist sans, no serif except rare editorial pull-quote. Display and label type is uppercase.

nodes.label: Scanline Overlay Effect
nodes.rationale: Single body::after, fixed, full viewport, pointer-events:none. Mandatory on public home page; opt-in elsewhere via .scanlines class on wrapper. Only one node for entire app — do not duplicate per component.

nodes.label: CRT Power-On Boot Animation
nodes.rationale: One-shot on app load, never loops. Respects prefers-reduced-motion. Applied once to app root.

nodes.label: Top Navigation Bar Component
nodes.rationale: Fixed top, 48px height, surface bg, z-index 200. Tabs formatted as [PUBLIC] [ANALOG] [DIGITAL]. Active tab: phosphor text + 2px phosphor underline with glow-phosphor. Mobile collapses to hamburger drawer.

nodes.label: Photo Card Component
nodes.rationale: Masonry layout, border-radius:0, 1px grid border. Format badge top-right: 35mm=phosphor, DIGITAL=amber. Hover reveals caption overlay translateY with 200ms cubic-bezier ease.

nodes.label: Lightbox Photo Detail Component
nodes.rationale: Full viewport overlay, void bg, z-index 300. EXIF readout below photo as terminal line with //-delimiters. Keyboard nav with arrow keys and Escape.

nodes.label: Upload Drop Zone Component
nodes.rationale: 1px dashed phosphor border, min-height 240px. Terminal progress bar as text blocks. Button becomes TRANSMITTING... while uploading with blinking cursor. Debounced to prevent double-submit.

nodes.label: Status Bar Component
nodes.rationale: Fixed bottom, 28px height, z-index 100. Zone dot color: phosphor=analog, amber=digital, neon-red=admin, fog=public. Persists at all viewport sizes.

nodes.label: CSS Architecture
nodes.rationale: All colors/fonts/spacing/radii/durations/z-index as :root custom properties. Components reference tokens only — no raw hex inside component CSS. Tailwind for layout only; scoped component CSS for aesthetic effects.

nodes.label: Z-Index Scale
nodes.rationale: content:1, scanlines:50, status:100, nav:200, lightbox:300, modal:400

nodes.label: Design Prohibitions
nodes.rationale: No rounded corners >2px. No white/near-white backgrounds. No sans-serif body. No gradients. No friendly/warm UI patterns. No soft drop-shadows. No glow on body/EXIF text. No spinners. No emoji. Never make light mode default.
